<!-- MtLoginPage.vue -->
<template>
  <v-main style="height: 100%" class="login">
    <v-container fluid fill-height>
      <v-row
        align-content="center"
        justify="center"
        class="d-flex flex-column align-center"
      >
        <MtCard class="loginWindow pa-6">
          <MtCard
            v-if="!isSelectControlset & !needToUpdatePassword"
            flat
            :width="loginCardWidth"
            class="login-dialog d-flex flex-column align-center"
          >
            <!-- ログインフォーム -->
            <v-form @submit.prevent="login">
              <MtTextField
                v-model="account"
                outlined
                label="account"
                prepend-icon="mdi-account"
                style="padding: 100px 0px 16px 0px"
              />
              <MtPasswordTextField
                v-model="password"
                label="password"
                style="padding-bottom: 30px"
              />
              <v-btn
                :loading="loading"
                color="success"
                size="large"
                type="submit"
                variant="elevated"
                block
              >
                LOGIN
              </v-btn>
            </v-form>
          </MtCard>
        </MtCard>
      </v-row>
    </v-container>
  </v-main>
</template>

<script>
import MtCard from "@/components/MtCard.vue";
import MtTextField from "@/components/MtTextField.vue";
import MtPasswordTextField from "@/components/MtPasswordTextField.vue";

export default {
  components: {
    MtCard,
    MtTextField,
    MtPasswordTextField,
  },
  props: {
    //
  },
  data: () => ({
    height: 0,
    width: 0,
    pageHeight: 0,
    pageWidth: 0,
    viewHeight: 0,
    viewWidth: 0,
    account: "",
    password: "",
    loading: false,
  }),
  mounted: async function () {
    this.onResize();
  },
  computed: {
    //
  },
  methods: {
    onResize: function () {
      this.height = window.innerHeight;
      this.width = window.innerWidth;
      this.pageHeight = window.innerHeight - 12; // 上下6pxずつ取ってる
      this.pageWidth = window.innerWidth - 12; // 左右6pxずつ取ってる
      this.viewHeight = this.pageWidth * 0.6;
      this.viewWidth = this.pageWidth * 0.8;
    },
    login: async function () {
      this.loading = true;
      let result = false;
      await this.$mtapi.auth
        .login(this.account, this.password)
        .then((response) => (result = response.data))
        .catch((err) =>
          alert("error " + JSON.stringify(err.response.data.message))
        );

      if (result) {
        alert("result");
        this.loading = false;
      } else {
        location.reload();
      }
    },
  },
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.login {
  background: radial-gradient(#ffccff, #cc99ff) fixed;
}
.loginWindow {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 24px;
}
.login-dialog {
  opacity: 0.9;
}
</style>
